assessment: Evidence-backed developer preview; independent third-party setup and first-run delivery remain incomplete.

findings.summary: R4 activation retains ambient PYTHONPATH/LD_LIBRARY_PATH and enables user site-packages; two isolated sentinel probes confirmed external module visibility.
Video and check-only entrypoints retain the original workstation boot/storage policy; stdlib function probes rejected this target. Original workstation guards must be preserved.
Pinned snapshots and native asset records exist, but supported-target bootstrap and empty-prefix reconstruction are not accepted.
Setup/results/website still describe prior server or R4 states while README and PLAN describe newer components.
Exploratory R2 execution uses research acceptance as the top-level status and exit-code contract; missing events/review prevent acceptance even with generated artifacts.
No clone-to-small-example delivery regression; all 44 workspace R4 script files and four tests are absent from HEAD; no root packaging/task configuration or CI files found.
Project-wide license/publication scope remains undecided; repository stays private and no license was selected.

verification.source_parsing_scope: Two R2 files parsed solely to extract read-only policy/storage functions; not a whole-project syntax check.
verification.gpu_visibility_observation: No /dev/nvidia* in this sandbox; nvidia-smi exited 9. This does not diagnose the host driver or invalidate historical checks.

concurrent_changes: Closeout detected separate W&B dependency updates and R4 research-module edits; preserved and recorded in the raw preservation review. They are not implementation or validation performed by this audit.
